description: Tinker is Thinking Machines Lab's training and sampling API for open-weight models. Its OpenAI-compatible inference endpoint supports Inkling sampling and is documented as beta.
prompt_training_notes: Thinking Machines says customer data is used solely to fine-tune customer models and is not used to train its own models.
regional_pricing_notes: Thinking Machines publishes a single public USD rate card for Tinker model sampling and training.

sources.notes: Beta OpenAI-compatible host, Tinker API-key authentication, Chat/Completions routes and sampler-checkpoint model requirement.

verification.notes: The compatible endpoint requires a user-owned tinker:// sampler checkpoint. Static base-model catalog rows cannot be routed through it and are disabled.
